about: Open-weight models run on GitHub's free CPU runners with no key, as blind voters on the owner's bench (server/runner-voters.js; the owner, 14 Oct: "make free workers without apis", "use both"). Each is a family none of the live voters is, small enough for a free runner (4 CPUs, 7 GB of memory assumed, under 6 hours a job), under a licence that allows commercial use, read on the date given. `name` is the voter's name in RUNNER_VOTERS; `file` the quantised weights fetched at run time, never committed.
